alt: DMHC Response to Grievance regarding L.A. Care Health Plan and transportation denials (June 26, 2026) - Page 2. The letter concludes that L.A. Care Health Plan complied with the contract and law, and provides contact information for DHCS.
full_text: Nicolas Hernandez Case #[REDACTED]44 June 26, 2026 Page 2 Department of Health Care Services Office of the Ombudsman Telephone: 888-452-8609 MMCDOmbudsmanOffice@dhcs.ca.gov DHCSNMT@dhcs.ca.gov The Department determined that L.A. Care Health Plan complied with your health plan contract and California health plan law about the issue(s) in your complaint. The Department's review of your complaint does not prevent you from pursuing other legal options that may be available, including contacting an attorney. If you have questions, please call us toll-free at 1-888-466-2219. You may also go to our website at www.DMHC.ca.gov, which has more information about the Department and consumer health care rights in California. Sincerely, Standard Complaint Branch Help Center Department of Managed Health Care cc: Local Initiative Health Authority for L.A. County
summary: Page 2 of the official DMHC response dated June 26, 2026. The Department concludes that L.A. Care Health Plan complied with the health plan contract and California law regarding the transportation access issues, reflecting a regulatory deflection by allowing the plan to internally handle the problem.
